verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports writing and testing custom rules via its pattern-matching DSL and Editor (docs-4, docs-5, docs-21), which is generically applicable to detecting custom token/secret formats using pattern or regex-based rules, and community evidence confirms security engineers actively write custom rules for org-specific patterns (comm-1). While Semgrep Secrets provides built-in detectors for common providers, the general custom-rule authoring capability directly satisfies the need to define detection rules for internal/proprietary secret formats.
